system.description:
When using this skill, you may spend up to three [Fate Points] (0 is okay). You gain a +[(Spent [Fate Points] + SR) x 5] bonus to [Weapon Attack] damage rolls.

(CR11): The multiplier bonus becomes x10. (CR21): The multiplier bonus becomes x15.

A special skill that unleashes continuous attacks with dance-like movements that even the enemy will be fascinated by. The trajectory of the weapon glowing with blood smoke becomes a dance of death, stealing the life of the enemy with the sword.
